'''Paig''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]

==History==
Five [[Fallanassi/Legends|Fallanassi]] children were sent to Paig for safekeeping after the religious sect was persecuted on the planet [[Lucazec/Legends|Lucazec]].
